CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (OS) clearly missed - HR 1.06 (95% CI: 0.8-1.4), p=0.24. Neither combination nor monotherapy arms showed survival benefit. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Study appears adequately powered (n=356) and duration was appropriate (156 weeks). failure_modes.evidence: Primary OS endpoint missed (HR 1.06, p=0.24) despite adequate sample size and duration. No biomarker data to confirm whether upstream biology was engaged, but the failure to improve survival suggests the intended biological effects did not translate to clinical benefit.
